items.title: Commutativity of derived global sections with the derived pushforward and the restriction of scalars
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces f: X to Y, the lemma exhibits the commutativity of the diagram comparing derived global sections on X composed with the derived pushforward against derived global sections on Y followed by restriction of scalars along the map on global functions, and its relative version for an open V of Y with U its inverse image (statement lines 2091-2114). The proof is a comparison of functors before deriving: the author introduces the functor taking an O_X-module to its global sections regarded as an O_Y(Y)-module, observes that it is the composite of the restriction functor with global sections on X and also of global sections on Y with the pushforward, and notes that the restriction functor is exact so that its derived functor is itself (proof lines 2117-2136). Commutativity then follows from the composition lemma for derived functors, which the author checks applies to both compositions: this is clear for the first, and for the second it follows because injective O_X-modules are pushed forward to sheaves acyclic for global sections on Y (proof lines 2137-2143). The claim is H2: a functor-level identity plus an acyclicity check, with the exactness of restriction of scalars doing the bookkeeping.
